channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Dollar Erases Liberation Day Loss as ‘Sell America’ Fear Fades
item.description: The dollar has recovered all of its decline since President Donald Trump announced tariffs on so-called Liberation Day. A resilient economy, rising interest rates and the artificial intelligence boom have boosted the US currency’s appeal.

item.title: Top stocks to watch today: Senco Gold, Adani Enterprises, BSE, Cipla shares in focus on Tuesday, 17 November | Full list
item.description: Indian markets may open subdued on Tuesday amid weak global cues, after the Sensex and Nifty rose in the previous session. Stocks in focus include Senco Gold, Adani Enterprises, BSE, Cipla, HDFC Life, Lemon Tree Hotels, Hero Motors, Vedanta, SML Mahindra, Urban Company, Capri Global and ARSS Infra.

item.title: Stock market outlook today,17 Nov:Sensex, Nifty prediction-DJIA, S&P, NASDAQ, GIFT Nifty, Kospi, Nikkei, Taiwan cues
item.description: Indian markets are expected to open sideways on Tuesday as weak global cues weigh on sentiment ahead of Nvidia’s earnings. The Sensex and Nifty rose on Monday, supported by financial, FMCG and energy stocks, while foreign inflows and lower crude prices helped.&nbsp;

item.title: Stock recommendations for 17 November from MarketSmith India
item.description: MarketSmith India reveals its top stock recommendations for today, 17 November. Get expert insights into the best-performing stocks to guide your investment decisions.

item.title: Raja Venkatraman recommends three stocks for 17 November
item.description: Market expert Raja Venkatraman shares his top stock picks for 17 November. Here’s his technical outlook and trade strategy.

item.title: China’s Buyback Push Struggles to Put a Floor Under Stocks
item.description: Chinese companies are tapping only a fraction of loans provided by Beijing for stock buybacks, an indication that the latest effort to support markets is faltering.

item.title: Berkshire Boosts Delta Stake to Almost 10% of Outstanding Shares
item.description: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. boosted its holding in Delta Air Lines Inc. and continued whittling its stake in Bank of America Corp in the third quarter.

item.title: Goldman Forecasts Gold to Take Two Years to Recapture All-Time Highs
item.description: It took gold just one month to climb more than 30% to a record, but its likely to take another two years before the precious metal takes out a new peak, according to Goldman Sachs.

item.title: AI and 24-Hour Trading Test Rules Governing Currency Markets
item.description: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence and round-the-clock trading is raising questions about whether rules governing the $9.5 trillion foreign-exchange market can keep pace with technological change.

item.title: Wall Street update: Why Walmart, Home Depot, Target, Lowe's stocks are in focus this week | Q3 earnings latest news
item.description: Investors will be watching whether retailers can sustain sales growth while protecting profit margins amid rising operating costs and cautious consumer spending

item.title: $51 billion capex, 23% earnings growth: Adani Ports, Adani Green to Energy; Jefferies sees up to 44% upside in 6 stocks
item.description: Jefferies maintained Buy ratings on six Adani Group companies, citing expected upside of nearly 25% on average. It forecasts a $51 billion capex programme to drive 23% annual EBITDA and earnings growth through FY29, while noting that credit profiles have improved.

item.title: Mid-cap stocks: AI-led short-cycle deals rise; Anand Rathi identifies mid-cap IT stocks Mphasis, Sonata set to benefit
item.description: Anand Rathi said Indian mid-cap IT firms recorded stronger-than-expected September-quarter revenue growth, while margins remained stable. It expects muted FY27 growth amid AI-driven pricing pressure and geopolitical uncertainty but sees longer-term opportunities in AI and modernization.&nbsp;

item.title: Crystal Crop Protection IPO GMP today: How much listing gain is expected? Check profit calculator before bidding starts
item.description: Crystal Crop Protection’s IPO opens on November 18 and closes on November 20, 2026. Its latest grey market premium of ₹13 suggests a potential 4.78% listing gain, with an estimated listing price of ₹285 against the ₹272 upper price band.

item.title: Wakefit Innovations share price down 29% from IPO price: Can the stock bounce back? InCred sees 35% upside - Target
item.description: Wakefit Innovations shares edged up 0.26% to ₹135.10 on Monday but remain about 29% below their listing price. InCred Equities maintained its Buy rating and ₹182 target, citing record second-quarter revenue, growing furniture sales and an expanding store network.

item.title: MSCI India earnings breaking out of two-year rut, says CLSA's Redman
item.description: Dollar-denominated earnings are showing signs of recovery, but currency depreciation, equity dilution and uncertainty over global AI valuations remain risks to India's market outlook, says CLSA's Alexander Redman.

item.title: AI disruption wipes out $206 billion in market value of 10 listed companies; which businesses are most at risk?
item.description: AI is reshaping online marketplaces, travel, creative tools and education. Ten publicly listed companies in exposed sectors have lost $206 billion in market value since 2021, even as their combined revenue initially grew.&nbsp;

item.title: Sebi panel to review IPO, FPO and QIP rules, rationalise disclosure norms
item.description: The review aims to identify ways to facilitate access to capital markets for eligible issuers while rationalising regulatory requirements, eliminating duplicative disclosures and procedures, and improving clarity and consistency, the regulator said.

item.title: Swiggy vs Zomato parent Eternal: Which stock has the stronger growth and better earnings outlook after Q2 results?
item.description: Eternal outperformed Swiggy in the September quarter, with revenue up 77.6% and profit rising 92%. Swiggy’s revenue grew 36% and its year-on-year loss narrowed, but losses widened sequentially as quick-commerce investment weighed on results.

item.title: Nvidia stock plunge threatens US retirement savings: How a 30% decline could hit 401(k) investors
item.description: Nvidia’s substantial weight in major stock market indices means that its performance can significantly influence the value of retirement portfolios

item.title: 13% rally in 2 weeks, but 67% upside still left? InCred bullish on this small cap stock - Do you own? Check target price
item.description: Techno Electric reported strong Q2 FY27 results, with revenue rising 31.4% and EBITDA 63% year on year. InCred Equities maintained a Buy rating, citing data centre growth potential and projecting nearly 67% upside.&nbsp;

item.title: 42% rally in 11 sessions: This jewellery stock resumes its bull run after upbeat Q2 results, hits nearly 2-year high
item.description: Kalyan Jewellers shares rose 42% in November, closing at a nearly two-year high after gains in 10 of 11 sessions. Strong quarterly results, including 64% profit growth and 32% revenue growth, fueled the rally, while brokerages cited demand and expansion in their updated outlooks.

item.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: Dividend king in the making? What top official says about Coal India arm's post-listing payouts
item.description: Mahanadi Coalfields’ ₹8,981-crore IPO, an offer for sale by Coal India, opens on November 19. Ahead of the listing, investors are watching the company’s dividend prospects.

item.title: Ola Electric vs Ather Energy: Ather shines, Ola struggles in Q2; which EV stock offers better upside?
item.description: Ather Energy outperformed Ola Electric in Q2 FY27, posting a ₹1.26 crore profit, 63% revenue growth and a second consecutive EBITDA-positive quarter. Ola’s revenue fell 39% and its EBITDA loss widened.&nbsp;

item.title: Sebi weighs biometrics, geotagging for trading terminals
item.description: Sebi, ISF discuss biometric checks to restrict terminal access to authorized users

item.title: Belrise Industries shares surge 13% after Q2 results, H-One merger; stock rallies 44% in a year — What technical experts
item.description: Belrise Industries shares jumped 13% after Q2 FY27 revenue rose 16.7% year on year to ₹2,746.3 crore and adjusted profit increased 25% to ₹166.3 crore. Growth across vehicle segments and new automotive, electronics and aerospace orders supported the quarter.

item.title: Tata Motors PV vs Eicher Motors: Which auto stock is set to race ahead, and which should you buy after Q2 results?
item.description: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles shares fell sharply after weaker results and reduced JLR guidance, while Eicher Motors reported stronger growth, led by Royal Enfield demand.&nbsp;

item.title: Vikram Solar vs Premier vs Waaree vs Suzlon: Green energy stocks under pressure - What do technical charts signal?
item.description: Shares of Vikram Solar, Premier Energies, Waaree Energies and Suzlon Energy fell on Monday amid volatile markets and bearish technical signals.&nbsp;

item.title: Why Vodafone Idea’s q-o-q drop in mobile subscriber base is a worrying sign
item.description: Instead of Q2 revenue and profitability, investors should focus on cash Ebitda, given Vodafone’s heavy capital expenditure and government debt burden of almost ₹1.5 trillion.

item.title: Amber Enterprises shares resume losing run, tank over 8% after weak Q2 from peer Kaynes Technology. Is more fall ahead?
item.description: Amber Enterprises shares fell 8.4% on 16 November as weaker-than-expected results from peer Kaynes Technology hurt sentiment toward electronics manufacturers.&nbsp;

item.title: TVS Supply Chain Solutions shares jump 17% after Q2 results, surge 24% in 2 weeks; what lies ahead? Key levels to watch
item.description: TVS Supply Chain Solutions shares surged 17% after Q2 FY27 revenue rose 38% year on year to ₹3,687.2 crore and net profit more than doubled to ₹36.5 crore. The company cited broad-based growth, operational improvements and strong new-business wins.

item.title: Why Kaynes Technology shares crashed 20% to 52-week low? stock down 54% in a year | What stock market experts say
item.description: Kaynes Technology shares hit 20% lower circuit after Q2 FY27 net profit fell 61.6% year-on-year, despite modest revenue growth. Brokerages cited weakness in smart metering, rising debt and uneven segment performance, while auditor observations and financial restatements added to investor concerns.

item.title: Coal India’s Mahanadi Coalfields IPO expected profit calculator on GMP: What retail, HNI investors can gain on listing?
item.description: Mahanadi Coalfields set its IPO price band at ₹129–136 per share for an ₹8,981-crore offer for sale. At a grey market premium of ₹4.50, the estimated listing gain is 3.31%. A 110-share retail lot costs ₹14,960, with an estimated profit of ₹495.

item.title: Eicher races to meet Royal Enfield demand wave amid margin woes
item.description: Eicher’s shares have gained nearly 12% in the past year, vis-a-vis just a 2% rise in the Nifty Auto index. Triggers could be limited in the near term, given looming margin woes. Besides, a lean dealer inventory could strain financials until additional production capacity comes online.
